Signed-in @ShizzyUnchained X discovery and focused official-account follow-ups, plus 196 associated public-account candidates, 186 usable samples and 226 unique current post records. Samples include commentators and quoted accounts, not only subnet teams.

184 associated repository paths screened, with 22 selected commit records read. Primary checks included SN78 UMI status, SN108 ChipForge leaderboard, SN120 Affine state, SN116 Carbon launch gates, SN66 Conjectures task and mathematical catalogue, SN30 Endure’s launch article, SN28 SayGM’s official program and litepaper, and open Subtensor PR3211.

Signed-in AlphaGap feed and leaderboard, SubnetRadar research and dated Moments, TAO Daily, and partner/infrastructure accounts checked as discovery. Manako’s Avia release and original TaoWeave SEC filing checked directly; older SEC material establishes the SN44 Score relationship.

September 30–October 6 editions reviewed for duplicates, late-found announcements, unresolved reward incidents and upcoming events. Full-roster market outliers, the top twelve emission recipients and indexed chain movements compared separately with story selection.

Both YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked while signed in. New members video w7yEF24XuFc verified at 5:29; new SN91 Cascade stream OWQoSVN3M9s scheduled October 7 15:00 UTC; mTJBFowN4Yo verified as 49:17 replay. Public default and prior replays retained.

accessGaps: Research cutoff 2026-10-07T14:44:53.172Z. Associated public-account samples and selected signed-in searches are not an exhaustive SN-number/name search for every subnet. No Grok scan, complete X archive or complete private-community access is claimed.

13 repository paths returned errors; 10 associated account candidates yielded no usable sample. Directory aliases can be stale. The SN44 legacy scorevision.io URL returned deployment-disabled 402; wearescore.com remained available.

Generated briefs and AlphaGap summaries were discovery, not independent confirmation. Team-attributed operational changes remain developing when original posts or rollout evidence were unavailable; member allegations were not promoted to verified facts.

SN44 Score’s Avia deployment is supported by primary company releases and an SEC filing, not an independent station-by-station audit. Contract value, resulting subnet revenue, precise miner-model provenance and linked buybacks remain undisclosed. Its consumer Studio measurements are a separate funnel.

SN51 lium.io’s reported 5,000 TAO alpha purchase, revenue funding, monthly billing and burn execution were not independently matched to a primary announcement and transaction. Our own X post is not independent corroboration. SN65’s provider integration is a separate primary announcement.

SN66 Conjectures’ claimed Erdős resolution was not independently rerun; the catalogue still marked the problem open. Existing formal statements and target metadata do not establish the final proof. SN38 ChronoLLM, SN49 Nepher Robotics and SN21 AdTAO evaluations were not independently reproduced.

SN108 ChipForge displayed a winner but zero of three validators agreeing and no settled daily-reward total. The current primary threshold was 10%, despite a secondary 20% description. SN28 SayGM’s litepaper is project-authored deployment documentation, not independently checked contract state or affiliate receipts.

SN78 UMI rewards and chain authorization remain false. SN116 Carbon’s public development/testnet limits remain despite conference launch wording, and its seven-day slot return crosses registration. SN120 Affine’s operator records do not prove learning gains or wallet receipts. SN111 Claims’ merged default is not an independently matched applied distribution.

SN30 Endure has a primary mainnet launch notice, but universal validator activation and outside paid rewards were not independently established. SN104 TAOstatus is testnet, targeting October 9; SN122 CookingTAO buyback-and-burn has not started; SN25 UR’s production handoff remains blocked.

SN118 Ditto, SN11 TrajectoryRL, SN54 Yanez UAV, SN44 Score’s separate evaluation issues, SN15 ORO Race 11 and SN81 Reliquary reward-backlog incidents are not independently closed. SN61 RedTeam replacement, SN68 NOVA delayed-payment all-clear, SN94 permissionless access, SN100 Apple-approved app backend and SN121 sundae_bar’s SBC30 remain unconfirmed.

SN124 Swarm’s hardware preview is not a customer deployment. SN96 Verathos recovery is secondary and partial. Cumulative SN93 Bitcast and TAO.com figures, SN71 Leadpoet sales and Yuma fund returns are not externally audited accounts. No swap, bridge, payment, trading transaction or members-access bypass was performed.

decisions.reason: The +17.449259% day / +21.230789% week alpha/TAO move prompted official AdTAO source review. Its newly published 28-day Google Ads evaluation and daily cohort scope are covered at three stars. No accuracy number was inferred from the image or causal link from price asserted.

The -3.287040% day / +276.152389% week alpha/TAO move triggered a fresh live leaderboard check: 42 submissions, 23 miners, five winner records, UID63 on-chain winner, 10% threshold and zero-of-three validator agreement. A winner record is not a settled payout; business progress, not price, earns four stars.

The -15.802934% day / +2161.993340% week alpha/TAO moves triggered a primary README and project-status review. Development/testnet and production reward gates contradict broad conference launch wording. The weekly history spans October 4 registration and is not Carbon performance.

posts.text: NIOME @NiomeAI When Aldo de Pape sat down with @ markjeffrey , he mentioned a new challenge going live the week after. That challenge is now here: our new drug-response challenge, pharmacogenomics, the science of how your genes decide the way you respond to medication. So it's a good moment to go back to what he explains in this cut: how NIOME actually works. Behind the subnet is genomes.io , a company building since 2018 on one idea: your genome belongs to you. The part most people miss is how a pharma company can study the data without ever seeing it. A query goes in, the answer comes back, and the genome itself never leaves its encrypted environment. That is the consent model underneath everything NIOME does. On top of that infrastructure sits the subnet, working through a roadmap of 24 scientific challenges planned out to 2027. The one he hinted at is now one of them. Six minutes on how the whole thing fits together. 00:00 2:37 PM · Oct 7, 2026 · 282 Views 1 1 1
